    I’m Errol Kelvin A. Tolentino, a fourth-year Information Technology student at National University Baliwag, specializing in Mobile and Web Development.

    What I enjoy most is the seam between things — a thoughtful interface, a backend that holds up under real data, and AI used where it genuinely earns its place instead of where it demos well. That’s taken me through health information, everyday wellness, learning platforms, and productivity tools.

    Along the way I’ve led student teams, taught what I was still learning, and defended research in front of an international panel. Now I’m looking for an AI or software engineering internship where I can do that work alongside people who’ll push me further.
